statusMeaning.exclude: Outside native scope per the linked decision; no port.

rows.change: /reload enables tools newly added to defaultTools; restored but unregistered tools stay pending.
rows.notes: Reload and late registration keep tools pending. Owner decision (2026-10-08): follow upstream v1.1.0 on open and tree navigation: unbound transcript tools become pending and activate on registration; tools disabled or excluded stay off. As upstream, CLI sessions opened with an initial selection (flags, settings or MCP) apply that selection instead of restoring the transcript. Burn-down: the opened or navigated loadout is recorded at the next prompt as Pi's declareToolChanges delta, idle selections stay in memory until then, and recorded declarations carry the prepareLoadout descriptions. Also as upstream: a recorded tool whose declaration changed is restored by name with its current binding, a now-hidden recorded tool is skipped and stays pending, and navigating to a branch with no system message keeps the current tools. Owner decision (2026-10-08): unknown names in --tools, defaultTools, SDK initial names and explicit activation select nothing and never become pending; a --tools allowlisted MCP tool activates when it registers. codemode and tool_search are always registered and activate from initial names (gap.codemode, gap.tool-search).

Full parity (IMPL-C, IMPL-H, burn-down): codemode servers connect; the trusted project .pi/mcp.json is read; the first prompt waits up to 10 s for direct servers; tool_search, codemode scripts and resource tools wait for the servers they need, and late tools publish during the run; background servers get resource tools; the live and terminal routes send the mcp_servers section; /mcp manager.
